source.citation: J. Chen et al., Physics of Plasmas 32, 113502 (2025)
source.extraction_note: Only values stated in article text are numeric here. No 0.15% time-resolved curves are published to digitize.

bank_efficiency.provenance: Article text says approximately 5.8%; no numeric uncertainty is published.

laser_output_energy_j.provenance: Derived exactly from the two text values 1.62 J and 5.8%; it is not an independently digitized datum.

time_resolved_observables.availability: Figures 10 and 15-17 plot 0.05%, 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.3%, 0.4%, and 0.5% F2, not 0.15%. Figure 18 includes the 0.15% sweep point but the article text states only its approximate CE.

validation_policy: Do not interpolate the unpublished 0.15% waveform vector or assign invented plot-reading uncertainties. Compare 0.10% and 0.20% published curves separately once their figure pixels are reproducibly digitized.
